title: Existence of finite affine pair, overlap and subordinate triple refinements
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] which is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. There exist a finite affine refinement shape $K$ and affine opens $(C_d)_{d\in\operatorname{Fin}(K.\mathrm{size})}$ forming a valid collection [def-trf-finite-affine-refinement-collection]: the main charts cover $X$, the specified pair charts cover pair intersections of main charts, the overlap charts cover intersections of pair charts belonging to the same pair cover, and the triple charts cover triple intersections of main charts and are each contained in a chart of each of the three pair covers. The additional incidence set may be empty. Empty schemes and empty covers are allowed.

source.place: Tag 01ZR, lemma-descend-modules-finite-presentation, first proof, finite Zariski gluing preparation; Schemes Tags 01IT and 01KO

proof.text: Choose a finite affine cover of X. For each pair of its members, quasi-separatedness makes the intersection quasi-compact. Choose a finite affine cover of each such intersection.

For every two affine pair charts choose a finite affine cover of their intersection, using quasi-separatedness again. This supplies all the required pair-chart overlap covers, including pairs belonging to any common main pair cover.

For three main charts a,b,c and choices r,s,t in their ab, ac and bc pair covers, cover the intersection of the three pair charts by finitely many affines. The union of these covers over r,s,t covers the main triple intersection: a point in the triple can be placed in a member of each pair cover. Each new chart is contained in the three pair charts indexing it. Threefold intersections are quasi-compact by iterating the quasi-separated intersection criterion.

Take the disjoint sum of the main, pair, overlap and triple label types. These types are finite since finite dependent sums are finite. Identify the sum with Fin n and transport the chosen opens. Define the main, pair, overlap and triple finsets as images of their respective label types. The stored pair labels of each triple chart define its subordinate triple. Use an empty additional incidence set. Finite supremum identities give the covering fields; containment in the three pair charts follows from membership in the chosen affine cover of their intersection. This constructs every field of Valid. The same construction applies when any indexing type is empty.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01ZR first proof; explicit finite cover and label construction for Step 2 of lem-trf-fp-affine-limit-chart-models

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteAffineRefinementCollection (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] :
    ∃ (K : FiniteAffineRefinementShape) (C : Fin K.size → X.Opens), K.Valid C
